newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.86 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes unchanged at 14.86 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed unchanged at 14.86 ringgit ($5.94) a kg, with demand staying steady despite overnight losses on the London Metal Exchange.
"Buyers and sellers matched positions but sentiment for off-take was good despite the lower LME," said a trader. The LME closed $20 down on Thursday.

Turnover fell to 72 tonnes from 89 tonnes on Thursday. There were initial bids for 71 tonnes against offers for 79. Dealers said the local price fetched a premium of $70 against the LME, compared to $50 on Thursday. Buyers were Europeans and locals.
